units.T1..T4, time: log2 of a count of F_2 (Weil-descent) operations / solves; no conversion to group operations
units.T5: log2 of a count of F_2 field elements (= bits for p = 2)
units.margins: bits, Nagao minus vOW, positive = Nagao worse; NO unit conversion applied on either axis

vow_n571.time_only_point: M = 1, w -> infinity: T = W(1/1 + 0) = W
vow_n571.product_min_locus: every point with w = M (any common value); T*Mem = 6 n W there

arith.definition: lambda = E[prod_i #Fb_i]/p^n = p^{k m - n} (mean p^k per coset; any of P1/P2/P3)

geo_cond_P1.definition: log2 lambda = sum_i E[log2 #Fb_i | #Fb_i > 0] - n (typical instance)

geo_uncond_P1.definition: E[log2 #Fb_i] = -inf since P[#Fb_i = 0] > 0; degenerate; P[all nonempty] reported instead

geo_cond_P2.definition: log2 lambda = sum_i E[log2 #Fb_i | #Fb_i > 0] - n (typical instance)

geo_uncond_P2.definition: E[log2 #Fb_i] = -inf since P[#Fb_i = 0] > 0; degenerate; P[all nonempty] reported instead

geo_cond_P3.definition: log2 lambda = sum_i E[log2 #Fb_i | #Fb_i > 0] - n (typical instance)

geo_uncond_P3.definition: E[log2 #Fb_i] = -inf since P[#Fb_i = 0] > 0; degenerate; P[all nonempty] reported instead

inst_avg_cond_P1.definition: T4 = -log2 E_instances[1 - exp(-lambda) | all cosets nonempty], FFT convolution on a 2^-10-bit grid

inst_avg_uncond_P1.definition: as inst_avg_cond times P[all nonempty] (an empty coset gives lambda = 0)

inst_avg_cond_P3.definition: T4 = -log2 E_instances[1 - exp(-lambda) | all cosets nonempty], FFT convolution on a 2^-10-bit grid

inst_avg_uncond_P3.definition: as inst_avg_cond times P[all nonempty] (an empty coset gives lambda = 0)

nagao_literal_Pr_1_reference_only.definition: Pr = 1; not a HEUR-2 reading; equals ARM M's free-yield null; reference only
